title: AH & Vault Sync v5.0 — Complete Guild Data Pipeline
subtitle: Unified architecture for auction prices, guild bank, and bank alt inventory sync
description: Complete design specification for AH & Vault Sync v5.0: the guild's automated data pipeline connecting TurtleWoW game client data to the tbcguild.duckdns.org website. This document covers the unified tray application, three WoW addons (GuildShopSync, GBankExport, BankAltExport), server APIs, website UI, testing plans, and phased implementation roadmap.

issues: v4.0 unified tray app compiled but installer never built — tray icon disappears on reboot
GuildShopSync v3.0 running via old Scheduled Task mechanism
GBankExport running via PowerShell AutoExport.ps1 (VBS startup)
No bank alt inventory scanning capability exists
Guild bank data not uploading to website (local export only)

features: Single unified tray app auto-starts on Windows login (Registry Run key)
Desktop shortcut and Start Menu entry for manual launch
Survives all reboots — fully compiled .NET, no PowerShell
Three data pipelines: AH prices, guild vault, bank alt inventories
All data uploads to website automatically
Website displays combined guild storage view

dataTypes: Bank alt bags (5 bags per character)
Bank alt personal banks (24 slots + 7 bags)

decisions.rationale: Different data structures (per-character vs per-guild), different scan triggers, cleaner separation of concerns
Reduces file watcher complexity, character data aggregates naturally in one file
WoW API only allows bank access while at banker, cannot read stale data
Unified 'Guild Storage' concept, combined view only makes sense when data is together
SavedVariables only flush to disk on reload/logout, tray app polls disk files

questions.question: Which accounts and characters are used as bank alts?
questions.context: Need to know what characters will be scanned for accurate testing

questions.question: Should the bag scan trigger on every bag change, or only on manual /bae scan?
questions.context: Frequent bag changes could cause many uploads, but manual scan might miss updates
questions.default: Auto-scan on login + manual scan, not on every bag change

questions.question: Should we show bank alt data per-character or only aggregated?
questions.context: UI complexity vs. usefulness of seeing exactly where items are
questions.default: Show both — expandable per-character view with aggregated totals

questions.question: Priority of Phase 1 completion?
questions.context: Should we fix v4.0 reboot survival first, or proceed directly to bank alt design?
questions.default: Fix v4.0 first — stable foundation before adding features
